# Claude Notes

Claude Notes applies a Claude-inspired visual style with muted colors, clear typography and tidy spacing. It aims at a calm, distraction-free workspace that mirrors the Claude interface.

![Claude Notes screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timagestuff/Claude-Notes/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Claude Notes"
    author: "TimageStuff"
    repo:   "timagestuff/Claude-Notes"
    slug:   "claude-notes"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/claude-notes"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/timagestuff/Claude-Notes"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timagestuff/Claude-Notes/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["light"]
    about: "Apply a Claude-inspired visual style to Obsidian with muted colors, clear typography, and tidy spacing. Create a calm, distraction-free workspace that mirrors Claude's interface for focused writing and reading."
}
```
